summary: Los Banos Municipal Airport (LSN) is a small general aviation airport serving the city of Los Banos in Merced County, California's Central Valley. It primarily supports recreational flying, flight training, and agricultural aviation operations common throughout the region. The single-runway facility provides a convenient base for private pilots serving the western San Joaquin Valley.
faqs:
Q: What type of airport is Los Banos Municipal Airport?
A: It is a small general aviation airport serving private, recreational, and agricultural aircraft.

Q: Does Los Banos Municipal Airport offer commercial flights?
A: No, it does not have scheduled commercial airline service; it serves general aviation only.

Q: Where is the airport located?
A: It is situated in Los Banos, California, in the western San Joaquin Valley, southeast of the San Francisco Bay Area.

Q: What facilities are available at the airport?
A: The airport features a single runway and typically offers fuel services, tie-down parking, and basic amenities for transient pilots.
transport_tips: The airport is located just a few miles west of downtown Los Banos, easily reachable by car via local roads. Rental cars are not available on-site, so arranging ground transportation in advance is recommended. Visitors from the Bay Area can reach the airport in roughly two hours by car via Interstate 5 or Highway 152.
local_tip: If you're flying in for the annual Catfish Derby or to visit nearby San Luis Reservoir, plan your arrival early in the morning—Central Valley summers get extremely hot, and early flights offer the best flying conditions.
